content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's great, congrats on locking it in.

Next lock your headcount. Get a real number to the venue so they can confirm seating and staffing, since that shapes everything else.

Then sort the menu with them, any dietary notes from your guests, and whether it's a set menu or something more casual.

After that, get invites out with the date and address so people can plan around it. Last, confirm the small stuff closer to the date: start time, whether they need AV or a mic if anyone's speaking, and how seating should be arranged.

What kind of dinner is this, a small group or something bigger?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
